RoomType.rationale: SoulNexusElite declares RoomType.Elite; soul_nexus is listed only in elite_keys, not normal/weak/boss_keys -- matches.

AllPossibleMonsters.rationale: Single-element superset, identical to the fixed roster on both sides -- no divergence possible.

GenerateMonsters.rationale: One monster, no slot tag (null both sides), zero RNG draws either side.

ShouldReceiveCombatHooks.maps_to: the Encounter dataclass (sts2_rl/monsters/base.py) is never registered as a hook listener; only Monster instances register themselves
ShouldReceiveCombatHooks.rationale: Same structural fact as every unit in this batch.

guards.what: MinGoldReward/MaxGoldReward -- not overridden, inherits the Elite ladder (35-45) x Poverty multiplier
guards.rationale: sts2_rl/rewards.py GOLD_REWARD_RANGES[RoomType.ELITE] = (35, 45) and SOUL_NEXUS_ELITE sets neither min_gold nor max_gold -- matches. Ascension/Poverty scaling is out of scope per PROMPT.md and not modelled by rewards.py.

guards.what: ShouldGiveRewards / IsWeak -- neither overridden, both default (true / false)
guards.rationale: Encounter.should_give_rewards defaults True and is unset here; soul_nexus never appears in weak_keys, matching IsWeak's inherited false. (Elite encounters have no weak variant in either tree.)
